name: anselmoo-brand
description: Tools of the personal brand system: token derivation, imagery, page and README generators, checks.

scripts.chroma: node _scripts/check-chroma.mjs tokens/colors.css tokens/tokens.json styles.css components/components.css imagery/*.svg imagery/*.json assets/*.svg assets/og/*.svg assets/icons/*.svg assets/icons/platform/*.svg
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run imagery && npm run hero && npm run figures && npm run mark && npm run og && npm run index && npm run readme && npm run colophon
scripts.check: npm run content && npm run icons && npm run classes && npm run chroma
